Steps to reproduce:

Having received an email containing an event, after having added it to the calendar, the "Add" button from the email view changes to a "Details" one.

Actual results:

However, on clicking on it, nothing happens, and the following error pops in the developer console:

Uncaught TypeError: can't access property "openTab", tabmail is null

executeAction chrome://calendar/content/imip-bar.js:389
oncommand about:message:1

Expected results:

The event details window should open
